description: For infinite cardinals kappa and lambda, if every mu less than kappa has mu to the lambda less than kappa and lambda is below the cofinality of kappa, then kappa to the lambda equals kappa.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.ContinuumFunction.power_below_cofinality.{u} (κ τ : Cardinal.{u}) (hκ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ)
  (hτ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ τ) (hsmall : ∀ μ < κ, μ ^ τ < κ) (hcf : τ < κ.ord.cof) : κ ^ τ = κ
